**Top pick: Soundcore Space One, about $80 with a code**

- It's the best overall pick under $100 in [Best Products' roundup](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/). They cite adaptive ANC, balanced sound, rotating ear cups and a good companion app. It's heavier than some rivals.
- The listed price is $99.99. [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/soundcore-space-one) says code AFSC20 takes $19.99 off, bringing it to about $80. It reports testing the code in Soundcore's cart on 2026-10-22, but the store's checkout has the final word.
- Specs: up to 40 hours with ANC on, Bluetooth 5.3 with multipoint, LDAC on Android (not while two devices are connected), 18-month warranty, 30-day returns. It has no sweat resistance, so it's not a gym pair.
- **[Buy at Soundcore's official US store](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one)**. This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you.

**Other good options**

- **Soundcore Space Q45:** [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones) calls it the best budget ANC headphone it has tested, with strong noise isolation. It "hovers around the $100 mark," so check the current price. [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/) lists it at $99 with a 50-hour battery (38 hours with ANC on), LDAC and multipoint.
- **Sony WH-CH720N, $99:** It weighs only 192 g, which makes it a good choice if you want light and comfortable. Source: [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/). That page is inconsistent, though. It names the Sony as its "top pick" but the text crowns the Q45, so treat its ranking loosely.
- **Edifier W820NB Plus, $79:** It has a 49-hour battery, LDAC and a sturdier build than the Q45, per [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/).
- **1MORE SonoFlow SE, $65:** This is the cheapest option, with a 70-hour battery, per [CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/). [TechRadar](https://www.techradar.com/audio/headphones/best-noise-cancelling-headphones) picked the related 1More SonoFlow Pro as its best under $100.
- **Soundcore Life Q30:** It's an older, cheaper pick. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/over-ear-headphones-under-100) says it blocks engine rumble and chatter well and gets about 44 hours of battery.

I only have a direct purchase link for the Space One. For the others, the linked pages list retailers like Amazon, Best Buy and Walmart. Prices change often, so confirm at checkout.

**Quick guide:** Choose the Space One for the best all-around value, the Sony for light weight, and the Edifier or 1MORE for the lowest price or longest battery.
